summary: Night is not the negation of illumination in every register; night can be when stars become visible.

satellites.title: The Night Air
satellites.evidence: Mencius’s Ox Mountain: cut every day, the hill still puts out shoots from 日夜之所息, what rests by day and night. So a person’s goodness is restored by the night air, 夜氣; if 夜氣不足以存, “the night air is not enough to preserve it”, they are not far from the beasts.

satellites.title: Not Resting, Day or Night
satellites.evidence: Analects 9.17: by the river, Confucius says 逝者如斯夫，不舍晝夜 — “it passes on like this, never resting, day or night.”
